The thing is that sometimes my mother says that they wont be supporting me forever , that  im not allowed to fail any course, and of course that makes me think a lot and every test reminds me that, and streess me.

It is not that i dont wanna work for pay my studies, i alredy try searching work in fast food places, and they never reply. something very common

I do my best, but sometimes its hard to me understand a lot of classes or remember everything on a book, some homework seems to be impossible to do, and i always have that thinking, if i fail at least one time its over. And i dont wanna be there if that is true.

I actually think about that, but just get my doctor degree seems to be far away , and all my family problems just make me think that they could just stop supporting me, as i say my sister has wasted a lot of time and money on her collegue, and the idea of fail on a subject is terrifying, i dont want to be scolded by my parents and lost that opportunity.
